decisions.reason: F4 omitted the completed-product exceptional-null-set convention. This is nonfatal for step 1.1: exp(-|u|^2) is continuous, every section is measurable, and Tonelli factors its integral into n one-dimensional Gaussian integrals. Corrected F4 to use zero extensions on exceptional null sets and explained why the actual Gaussian sections require no modification. Checked unit mass, scaling, heat-equation signs, polynomial Gaussian derivative bounds and dominated Gaussian tails; Countable Choice remains explicit and Statement unchanged.

F4 overstated completed-product Fubini-Tonelli by omitting zero extensions of section integrals on exceptional measurable null sets. The actual continuous Gaussian and polynomial-Gaussian products have measurable sections everywhere, so the defect does not invalidate these moment calculations. Corrected F4 and made mixed absolute integrability explicit using |xi xj| <= (xi^2+xj^2)/2. Checked odd reflection, integration by parts with vanishing boundary term, diagonal value 2t and total 2nt, including n=1. Statement and Countable Choice unchanged.

F5 omitted the exceptional-null-set convention of completed-product Tonelli. The Gaussian in step 1.2 is continuous with measurable sections everywhere, so its factorization remains valid; corrected the fact without changing the Statement. Checked A=(t+s)/(4ts)>0, b=xs/(t+s), the completed-square constant -|x|^2/(4(t+s)), and the prefactor (4pi(t+s))^(-n/2). The C1 change-of-variables supplier covers the translation y=b+z with determinant one, and the finite Gaussian integral proves absolute convergence at every x.

Confirmed fatal dependency-citation gap: the integral-invariance theorem assumes measure preservation, while the cited linear change-of-variables theorem does not cover translations. Added the existing translation-invariance theorem and derived that Tx(z)=x-z is a measurable measure-preserving involution by composing translation with reflection (absolute determinant one). Step 1.1 first proves q(z)=Gamma(z,t)P(x-z) integrable from the moment suppliers, then applies invariance to |q| and q, proving absolute convergence without circularity. Unit, linear, mixed quadratic and radial quadratic formulas all follow by finite expansion. Example, actual AC requirement and page contract unchanged.

Step 2.1 correctly displayed the dilation invariance lambda^n u(lambda x,lambda^2 t)=u(x,t), but its final sentence falsely assigned amplitude lambda^n to the later-time profile. At x=0 and lambda=2 that profile has amplitude 2^(-n). This is nonfatal to the stated example, whose two equations and invariance under the compensated dilation are correct. Replaced the sentence with u(x,lambda^2 t)=lambda^(-n)u(x/lambda,t), recording spatial scale lambda and amplitude lambda^(-n). Checked heat equation, unit mass and positive-time semigroup, and preserved the Example exactly.

F6 omitted that the primitive base point must lie in its interval, and also omitted the supplier interval nondegeneracy. Corrected it to an interval I with at least two elements and 0 in I. This is nonfatal for step 1.2, which applies it only to the smooth Gaussian density on R. Checked Phi(u)=1/2+integral_0^u phi, Phi prime positive, affine substitution with factor sqrt(2t), and the ordered Gaussian-tail difference. The interval indicator is in all finite Lp and Linfinity; a<b gives strict positivity and smoothness. Example unchanged.

Step 1.2 used reciprocal indices without excluding k=0, although the canonical natural numbers contain 0; H_(1/0) is undefined. This is a nonfatal finite-index convention defect: the Lipschitz and uniform-Cauchy arguments establish the stated necessity using any positive times tending to zero. Replaced all six H_(1/k) and both H_(1/ell) occurrences with H_(1/(k+1)) and H_(1/(ell+1)). Checked continuous differences have equal supremum and essential supremum on R, real completeness gives a uniform limit and uniformly continuous representative, and both jump witnesses have errors on sets of positive measure. Finite-p convergence and the Statement refuted remain unchanged.
